d: Patna Police have registered an FIR against stand-up comedian Yash Maheshwari over his alleged objectionable remarks about Bihar women and the Chhath Puja sindoor tradition. Yash faced widespread criticism after a video from his stand-up show went viral, in which he made controversial jokes about women wearing long sindoor during Chhath and made remarks about violence against Bihari women. Following the backlash, Yash issued a public apology.
